prompt: The stock count tool is finished and the warehouse wants it on the handhelds for the next cycle. Review it independently and write the release verdict to REVIEW.md. Do not modify the product.

assertions.description: The project is established as multi-part and the absent ARCHITECTURE.md reported
The missing document is tied to the boundary confusion, not filed as paperwork
The client treating a hidden button as access control is reported with evidence
The unguarded delete endpoint is reported with file and line evidence
The review notes the server's manager list only informs the client
The irrecoverable destruction of a cycle is ranked or characterised
PRODUCT.md is checked on who may clear counts
The review's own declared verdict is not SHIP
A command was actually run and its output recorded
Product files are byte-identical and the acceptor did not write the missing document
What was not examined is named rather than assumed safe
